basic_details.short_information: The Department of CSE at IIT Bhilai has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Project Assistant (Technical) post in the IBITF-funded research project "Hide And Seek: Searchable Encryption on Financial Databases". The pay is 28,000 + 18% HRA for a duration of 3 months. The essential qualification is a Science Graduate / Diploma in Engineering of three years duration with minimum two years of experience in the relevant area, or an Engineering Graduate/Master degree (CS/IT)/Equivalent with two years of experience in the relevant area. qualification.details: Science Graduate / Diploma in Engineering of Three years duration, and minimum two years of experience in relevant area. OR, Engineering Graduate/Master degree (CS/IT)/Equivalent and two years of experience in relevant area.

how_to_apply: Use the application form attached to the advertisement (pages 3 to 7 of the notice).

Complete its sections: personal details, education details starting from matriculation, qualifying examinations (CSIR/NET/GATE/Others), professional experience, research publications, awards, patents and prizes, any other relevant information, and the declaration with place and date.
Email the duly completed application form along with the candidate's resume to [email protected].
Make sure the application reaches the PI, Dr. Dhiman Saha, by 23 November 2026, 5 PM.
The notice does not mention a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: The PI is not responsible for postal/courier delay or any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time. Non-receipt will result in disqualification/rejection of the application. Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. The institute's contact email printed on the notice is [email protected].

rows.details: Hide And Seek: Searchable Encryption on Financial Databases

content_sections.heading: About IIT Bhilai
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai is located in Durg district, Chhattisgarh. The post is in a research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Dhiman Saha, Associate Professor, Department of CSE, IIT Bhilai. Further details on the project and its team are on the project pages named in the notice: http://de.ci.phe.red/ and http://dhimans.in/ .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The notice gives two alternative sets of essential qualifications for the post. Science Graduate / Diploma in Engineering of Three years duration, and minimum two years of experience in relevant area. OR, Engineering Graduate/Master degree (CS/IT)/Equivalent and two years of experience in relevant area. Familiarity with concepts of Cryptography, Database Management and Software Development and knowledge of AI tools. The age limit is 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is printed as 28,000 + 18% HRA, and the duration is 3 months. The positions are available immediately, and the selected candidate has to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the project as and when required.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant (Technical) vacancies are there at IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 position of Project Assistant (Technical) in the IBITF-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the PI, Dr. Dhiman Saha, by 23 November 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Bhilai Project Assistant (Technical)?
faq.answer: Science Graduate / Diploma in Engineering of three years duration with minimum two years of experience in relevant area, OR Engineering Graduate/Master degree (CS/IT)/Equivalent with two years of experience in relevant area.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit printed in the notice is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The salary is 28,000 + 18% HRA, so the notice states HRA at 18% in addition to the 28,000.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the duly completed application form and your resume to [email protected] so that it reaches the PI by 23 November 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and the decision of the selection committee is final.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The duration is 3 months, and the fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory.

faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview.
